info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Enterprise Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Approved Supplier Directory API enables users to retrieve detailed information about enterprise services based on a specific parameter. This endpoint supports queries for approved suppliers, facilitating access to essential business data for stakeholders in procurement, sourcing, and vendor management. Typical consumers include business analysts, procurement officers, and software developers who integrate supplier data into applications. Utilizing this API streamlines the decision-making process regarding supplier selection and management, enhancing operational efficiency.

get.description: Fetch detailed information about a specific approved supplier, identified by RES-100045. This endpoint allows you to access the supplier's data for verification and operational needs.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the parameters required to retrieve information from the approved supplier directory. Ensure that the necessary fields are provided in the correct format.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the approved supplier directory.

GetEnterpriseServiceByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation of the approved supplier directory. It is expected to be a string representing any required information or criteria for fetching the approved suppliers.
